npc_hal_brand.name: Hal
npc_hal_brand.look: A weathered, broad-shouldered man near fifty with a close-cropped grey beard, a white scar through one eyebrow and two fingers missing on his left hand, a quilted gambeson over a brown tunic, leather bracers and heavy boots.
npc_hal_brand.combat: a veteran: patient, hard to hit, hits hard
npc_hal_brand.personality: Calm, dry and demanding; has seen too many young fools die and would rather shout at you now than bury you later.
npc_hal_brand.values: discipline, a steady guard, people who get back up
npc_hal_brand.fears: sending green recruits to a real fight
npc_hal_brand.authority: Teaches the garrison's recruits and anyone else he thinks worth it.
npc_hal_brand.concerns: Bram is too eager by half; a stranger who can't hold a shield won't last a week on the roads.

windup.text: Every blow winds up first: step back out of reach, or meet it with a shield.
windup.line: Watch the shoulder, not the blade. It winds up; you step out or you block.
windup.lead: Every blow winds up first: step out of reach or block it.

brea.text: Mother Brea at the inn patches up every recruit who gets clumsy with a blade.
brea.line: Get cut, you go to Mother Brea at the inn. Everybody does, sooner or later.
brea.lead: Mother Brea at the inn patches up the recruits' cuts.

npc_hal_brand.persuaded_by: seeing someone take a hit and get back up
npc_hal_brand.style: Short, dry orders; a rare grin; never wastes words.

samples: Shield up. Up! You'd be dead twice.
Good. Now do it when it matters.
Everyone thinks they'll be brave. Most just get hit.
voice.habits: Gives orders in two or three words; praises with 'Good.'; counts mistakes out loud.
voice.never: flatters, rushes a lesson, or fights for real in the yard
voice.greeting: Looks you up and down: 'Here to watch, or here to learn?'

goals: Turn Bram into a soldier who'll live
npc_hal_brand.dislikes: show-offs, people who drop their shield

superstition.text: Hal would want to know how it works.

npc_bram_recruit.name: Bram
npc_bram_recruit.look: A gangly seventeen-year-old with a big nose and an eager grin, a padded jacket two sizes too large, rough brown breeches, and a wooden practice sword at his belt.
npc_bram_recruit.personality: Eager, boastful and kind; wants desperately to be a real soldier.
npc_bram_recruit.values: courage, Hal's approval, his mother's pride
npc_bram_recruit.concerns: Hal says his guard is a disgrace; he wants to show someone he's improving.

shield.text: Hal makes recruits hold the shield up until their arms shake.
shield.line: Hal makes us hold the shield up till our arms fall off. You'll see.
shield.lead: Hal makes recruits hold their shields up until their arms shake.

npc_bram_recruit.persuaded_by: being treated like a real soldier

samples: I nearly beat Hal once! Well. I nearly didn't fall over.
Watch his shoulder. That's what he says. I never can.
Are you joining? You should join.
My mother says I'll be a sergeant. Hal laughed.
voice.habits: Boasts, then admits the truth; asks if you're joining.
voice.greeting: Grins: 'Come to learn? Hal's tough. I'm Bram.'

npc_bram_recruit.likes: stories of battles, his practice sword
npc_bram_recruit.dislikes: cleaning the trough, being called boy

npc_hal_brand.text: terrifying and the best man alive

superstition.text: Bram would want to know how it works.
